bar.label: Uncommitted changes
bar.lockedByOther: The candidate is locked by {{owner}}. Wait until they commit or discard, or until the lock expires.
bar.pendingBlocks: A commit is waiting for confirmation. Confirm it or let it revert first.

perm.commit: Your role cannot commit or roll back configuration.
perm.edit: Your role cannot change the configuration.

discard.title: Discard all changes?
discard.body_one: {{n}} uncommitted change will be dropped and the lock released. Running configuration is not affected.
discard.body_other: {{n}} uncommitted changes will be dropped and the lock released. Running configuration is not affected.

redacted.password: Password changed (the value is never shown)
redacted.unknown: The candidate is locked by you but shows no visible difference: it may hold write-only changes such as passwords.

commit.title: Commit changes
commit.validating: Validating the candidate (schema, semantic rules, data-plane dry run)…
commit.notAppliedWarning_one: Not enforced yet: the data-plane agent does not implement {{domains}}. It is stored in the running configuration only.
commit.notAppliedWarning_other: Not enforced yet: the data-plane agent does not implement {{domains}}. They are stored in the running configuration only.

result.not-applied: Committed, but not applied to the data plane.
result.notApplied_one: Not enforced: the data-plane agent does not implement {{domains}} yet. The change is stored in the running configuration and will be applied when support lands.
result.notApplied_other: Not enforced: the data-plane agent does not implement {{domains}} yet. The changes are stored in the running configuration and will be applied when support lands.

confirm.titleMine: Your commit is waiting for confirmation
confirm.titleOther: A commit is waiting for confirmation
confirm.expected: — this is expected if you cut your own access.
confirm.expiredChecking: The confirmation window has closed. Checking what the device did…
confirm.expiredWaiting: The confirmation window has closed; the device reverts to the previous configuration. Waiting for it to answer…

confirmed.title: Commit confirmed
confirmed.body: The changes are kept and saved as revision {{revision}}.

confirmedElsewhere.title: Commit confirmed
confirmedElsewhere.body: The commit was confirmed from another session and saved as revision {{revision}}.

reverted.title: Commit reverted
reverted.body: It was not confirmed in time, so the device went back to the previous configuration. Your changes are still in the candidate.

confirm.notApplied_one: Stored but not enforced yet: {{domains}} (not implemented by the data-plane agent).
confirm.notApplied_other: Stored but not enforced yet: {{domains}} (not implemented by the data-plane agent).

sync.body: The running configuration and the data plane may disagree. The device is reconciling: {{reason}}
sync.agentDown: Validation and commits fail until the agent answers again. Editing the candidate still works.

problem.locked: The candidate is locked by another user
problem.stale: The candidate is out of date
problem.pending: A commit is waiting for confirmation
problem.unreachable: The request did not reach the API. It will be retried when the connection is back.

breakLock.title: Break the lock of {{owner}}?
breakLock.body: {{owner}} locked the candidate {{since}} (last change {{activity}}). Breaking the lock discards all of their uncommitted changes. This cannot be undone.
breakLock.confirm: Discard {{owner}}’s changes and break the lock

kit.saved: Saved to the candidate. Commit to apply it.
kit.changedElsewhere: This entry changed in the candidate since you opened the form (another session). Only your own edits were saved; reload to see the combined result.
kit.removeBody: The entry is removed from the candidate. The running configuration keeps it until the change is committed.

key.help: The name identifies the entry and cannot be changed later.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.intro: Pre-shared keys, private keys, certificates, passwords and tokens used by the configuration. The configuration only holds a reference such as psk/branch-1; the value is encrypted on the device, can be written but never read back. Changes here are stored at once, outside the candidate/commit flow: services that use the value switch to it the next time their configuration is applied (next commit).
secrets.adminOnly: Only administrators can add, rotate or delete secrets.
secrets.usage: Use the reference {{ref}} in configuration fields that ask for a secret. The value itself is never shown again.
secrets.valueNote: The value is sent to the device once and stored encrypted. It cannot be displayed or downloaded afterwards.
secrets.exists: {{ref}} already exists. Use Rotate to store a new value for it.
secrets.valueHelpPem: Paste the PEM block. Write-only: never shown again.
secrets.rotateNote: Stored at once, outside the candidate/commit flow. Services that use it switch to the new value the next time their configuration is applied (next commit). Revisions that used the old version keep it for rollback.
secrets.deleteBody: The secret and all its versions are deleted. The device refuses while the running configuration, the candidate or a pending commit still references it.
